N6-01.title: 초기 finite state 구성
N6-01.text:
primary curls 뒤 temporal mean update와 다섯 moment correction을 수행하여 j=0 상태를 만든다. 합격: Proposition9.5
의 B0=0.7,C0*=1.2와 (9.9),(9.10) 명세를 충족한다. 명세의 상수 없이 경험적 power slope만으로 인증하지 않는다.

N6-02.title: 전체 residual 재계산
N6-02.text:
R(u+δu,p+δp)=R(u,p)+Lu(δu,δp)+div(δu⊗δu)를 사용하며 매 substep 후 최신 압력을 복원한다. 합격: 독립 직접 PDE
평가와 decomposed residual이 오차 예산 내 일치한다. 기존 flat tail와 새 quadratic remainder를 장부에서 누락하지 않
는다.

N6-07.title: 고정 도메인과 차수 향상
N6-07.text:
σj=1/5+j/10, gj=hj/10 및 (9.17),(9.18)의 Km,ℓm,log powers를 추적한다. 합격: 모든 finite stage가 같은 q<qbig 도메
인을 사용한다. 단 한 번의 step에서 샘플 잔차가 늘면 정밀도/범위/상수부터 조사하고 차수 theorem과 혼동하지 않는다.

N6-08.title: 최종 local 합성
N6-08.text:
(9.21)에서 Aj,Bj,pj에 shrinking cutoff를 적용하고 curl하여 local field를 만든다. finite residual의 flat terms를 무조건 합
산하지 않는다. 합격: Lemma5.4의 tail 비교로 (9.20)을 연결한다. 평가 구간의 active indices와 생략 tail의 bound를 저장
하고 없으면 finite-stage approximation으로 제한한다.

typedDefinitions.Sstar: ell_ref^2; all fixed constants may contain finite nonnegative powers of Sstar
typedDefinitions.epsilon: Q_ref^h, exact positive source h, not binary64 replacement
typedDefinitions.zeta: exp(-a_a/log(X/Xa)^2-a_b/log(Xb/X)^2), a_a,a_b>0; zero outside original shell
typedDefinitions.M: For each fixed I in N0^5, |D^I f|<=C_I epsilon^alpha Sstar^b_I zeta delta^(-d_I); same common-torus representatives, theta independent, smooth radial zero extension. No pulse-envelope/auxiliary-rectangle condition.
typedDefinitions.W: For each fixed I in N0^5, |D^I A_(label,m)|<=C_I epsilon^alpha Sstar^b_I sqrt(zeta) delta^(-d_I) P(v); collect equal label/harmonic contributions before testing. Fixed supports and compatible common-torus lifts; P is a pointwise weight on0<=v<=Ls. Actual cutoff fields also have smooth temporal zero extension.
typedDefinitions.S: For each fixed I in N0^2, |D_(Z,T)^I F|<=C_I epsilon^alpha Sstar^b_I, with exact normalized radial measure/weight included.
typedDefinitions.momentNormalization: If fstar=Q^a fphysical, integral R^e Haar(fstar)dR = Q^(a-(e+1)/2) integral r^e Haar(fphysical)dr.
typedDefinitions.uniformity: C_I,b_I,d_I depend only on the fixed derivative order and original profile data forj=0; uniform across every original active band, label, copy and point on the SAME original instantiated domain.
typedDefinitions.quantifierOrder: For every fixed I there exist finite source-only constants C_I,b_I,d_I; NOT one constant uniform across all derivative orders.

sameOriginalDomain.bandFloorProof: q<2^(-(ell0+4)) implies -log2(q)>ell0+4. Every active |ell+log2(q)|<3/4 therefore has ell>=ell0.
sameOriginalDomain.compatibleAtlas: For any two prefix orders valid at this same q, every extra coefficient is exactly zero together with all derivatives. The backgrounds, phases, original matrices, Volterra solutions, H and fixed positive a coincide by ODE uniqueness. The actual monotone b_n>=2^n makes these prefix domains cover every q>0.
sameOriginalDomain.exactPrefixProof: The actual common b_n is monotone. For n>=N+1, b_n*q>=1; the original time cutoff and all its derivatives are exactly zero, including at the flat endpoint.
sameOriginalDomain.referenceChart: The original (R,Z,T), with T>=0, q=Q_ref*s>0 and 1/2<=s<=2.

auditPremiseScope.A: Not an independent p62 completion criterion. Actual positivity/frame/H bounds remain real dependencies where the norm proof uses them; the restricted N1 source application is already supplied by current primary and F/G evidence. A wholeallq M2 Rayleigh audit must not be added as a new N6-01 or N6-02 gate.
auditPremiseScope.B: Not an independent p62 completion criterion. The full infinite M2 coefficient/Picard holomorphic eta-strip theorem is not needed merely to re-differentiate the proved actual finiteN1 source functions. Existing proved actual N1 C2/proximity and every-fixed-order compact source constants are reused. No exterior heat holomorphy is required.

The original W/M/S definitions already permit Sstar powers, so those powers need no absorption.
